picks.title: PGExplainer: Parameterized Explainer for Graph Neural Network
picks.why: Six SciCoQA rows from an MLRC 2020 report, all on the code path behind the audited table; GNN explanation, so a different kind of paper from MatchDG.
picks.table: Table 2, PGExplainer explanation AUC, 6 cells, mean ± sd over 10 stated runs
picks.runtime: about 1 to 2.5 h for 10 seeds (estimated from the notebooks' saved timings, not run)
picks.risk: setup: TensorFlow 2.0 on Python 3.7, notebooks only, no seed loop, some wrong paths; its README links the reproduction report, which the blind run must not see.

picks.title: Label-Free Explainability for Unsupervised Models
picks.why: Not a graph paper: small PyTorch autoencoders on MNIST, so the pair covers two frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and two kinds of model. One SciCoQA row, from an MLRC 2022 report.
picks.table: Tables 1–2, pretext-task sensitivity on MNIST: 12 Pearson-correlation cells, mean ± sd over 5 runs
picks.runtime: about 1.5 to 4 h for 5 runs (inferred from 20 small trainings with early stopping, not run)
picks.risk: closest to MatchDG (PyTorch, MNIST); its known row is not on the audited table's path, so only the settings diff can score it; may exceed a 2 h budget.
